The issuer exhibits significant financial distress characterized by a severely weak liquidity profile (working capital of -$229M and a current ratio of 0.55), a highly leveraged capital structure (total liabilities-to-assets of 71.3% and liabilities-to-equity of 2.53x), and poor earnings quality (net margin of only 3.7% despite solid operating margins, indicating extremely high interest or non-operating expense burdens). These leverage and short-term solvency vulnerabilities place the firm well into speculative grade, consistent with a high risk of refinancing stress or default.

DECISION: B-
